headline: OAK @ LAA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is OAK 4.63 at LAA 5.47, with a projected total of 10.10. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (OAK -0.26, LAA -0.29), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.55, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sam Aldegheri has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Lowe, Denzer Guzman, Henry Bolte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Colby Thomas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
